scope: Optimize existing code — correctness, maintainability, performance, observability, security — without regressing the green verify gate or changing external behavior.
context: Must keep verify.sh green (fmt clean; clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean; cargo test --all-targets all pass; src-tauri cargo check clean). Real-systems-only (no mock providers/browser in product paths). No new dependencies without explicit justification. Every change surgical, reviewable, and behavior-preserving unless the run is an explicit behavior fix with a test. Mutate from the last KEEP, never a discard.
gate_criteria: C2: cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings is clean
C3: cargo test --all-targets — all tests pass, none removed/ignored to pass
C4: cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml is clean

fitness_panel.note: Each loop iteration targets ONE backlog item with its own objective metric (from optimizations backlog in the Goal artifact). The gate is the universal hard floor: any candidate with gate_pass=false is DISCARDED regardless of panel movement. KEEP requires gate_pass=true AND the target metric improved AND no panel regression AND validation set green.
